items.statement: Management monitors process condition and improvement actions, process owners assess capability, and QA evaluates all core processes.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: Direktor Enconeta odgovoran je da prati ocjene i stanje u procesima te prema

items.statement: Core-process capability is evaluated annually using indicators for nonconformities, corrective actions, personnel, equipment, conditions, and methods.

sources.source_locator: 6.1-6.2 Metode i ocjenjivanje procesa, page 4, lines 107-127

evidence_quotes.quote_original: Procesi se ocjenjuju, u pravilu, svake godine. Direktor može donijeti odluku i o drugačijim intervalima ocjenjivanja.

items.statement: Low process-capability scores require urgent corrective action, while intermediate scores require continual-improvement measures.

sources.source_locator: 6.2 Postupak ocjenjivanja i status procesa, page 4, lines 127-135

items.statement: The QA lead maintains records of completed process-capability measurements.
